notes: FY2025 and FY2026 consolidated actuals from the FY2025-26 annual report. FY2025 comparatives agree with the earlier reported-history file. These accounts close before the Molycop acquisition on 1 June 2026.

All monetary values are INR million; shares_outstanding_million uses million shares. EPS is INR/share. Other reserves exclude retained earnings. Statement dashes and NCI below the reporting rounding threshold are represented by zero.

Term debt includes current maturities; the short-term pool excludes those maturities. Interest accrued remains in other financial liabilities. Note 41(c) debt roll-forwards include accrued interest and are reconciled to these principal pools.

Reported operating EBITDA is revenue minus materials, inventory-change expense, employee expense and other expense. It excludes other income and includes the INR775.77m acquisition transaction expense. Adjusted EBITDA is a separate modeling choice.

FY2026 other bank balances include INR9585.33m deposits and INR0.48m unpaid dividend accounts. INR69.46m of the deposits are pledged. The cash/debt bridge excludes pledged and unpaid-dividend balances from available liquidity.

Primary cash-flow lines retain the report's signs and groupings. Cash capex INR1359.36m is distinct from asset/CWIP additions. ROU asset additions INR337.79m differ from new lease liabilities INR337.72m; both reported amounts are preserved.
PPE, ROU, intangible, CWIP, debt, equity and cash reconciliations retain source rounding. No balancing plug is inserted. FY2025 cash-flow finance addback differs from P&L finance cost as reported.

The standalone linked forecast is a legacy-only counterfactual from 31 March 2026; the default acquisition DCF separately applies acquisition funding and ownership. Do not add the two equity valuations together.
The complete acquisition-era consolidated balance sheet still needs detailed post-close balances and purchase-accounting inputs; these March statements do not establish those June values.

historical_drivers.method: Arithmetic mean of available annual ratios; closing-balance/sales convention. FY26 transaction costs removed from operating cost mix only. Tax is unadjusted total accounting tax / PBT, a cash-tax proxy rather than a statutory marginal tax rate.

assumptions.note: Approved revenue paths; evidence priority: management guidance, verifiable comparable consensus, historical ratios. Missing evidence is recorded as unresolved, never relabeled as guidance or history. Source review does not certify a statutory post-acquisition three-statement model.

shared.opening_bridge_rationale: June legacy cash is estimated. Q1 CFO after interest = one quarter of FY24-FY26 average (not reported Q1 CFO); Q1 principal is one quarter of March current maturities. Q1 capex/commissioning and other cash remain unresolved timing estimates.
shared.asset_rationale: Legacy March assets are rolled forward with assumed Q1 commissioning and reported Q1 D&A. Molycop annual D&A starts at June D&A x 12, split between the provisional intangible base / assumed 15-year life and a residual existing-asset charge; that residual is capitalized over 8 assumed remaining years. These are modeling asset balances, not reported PPE. No goodwill amortization or unverified acquisition tax shield.
shared.molycop_other_claims_rationale: Provisional reserve of INR4,748.50m converted from the source-currency proxy at the selected rate. Includes unallocated lease/pension/other claims and lower-level minority/JV uncertainty; not a verified fair value or a second deduction of Apollo ordinary equity. Sensitivity uses INR0/4,748.50/9,497.00m. Reconcile net-debt scope before replacement.
shared.preference_rationale: INR25,641.90m issue value is a provisional June-end fair-value proxy. Contractual return, redemption premium and exit rights are not quantified in the reviewed filings. The 12% PIK/cash schedule is an analyst stress assumption, NOT a disclosed coupon. Perpetual instrument: no invented mandatory redemption. DCF deducts today's claim once; future PIK is not subtracted again from FCFF.
shared.financing_rationale: FY27 legacy finance cost follows the INR1100-1200m management range, less reported Q1 expense; treated as cash interest provisionally. Later interest applies its implied annual rate to opening debt. Molycop FY27 interest + principal totals management INR6647.90m; INR5983.11m/664.79m split remains unverified. Subtract reported June interest instead of counting it again. Later Molycop 9% net-debt interest proxy, 70% retention, and lease repayment remain unresolved.
shared.tax_rationale: Legacy 24.4558% = FY24-FY26 mean total accounting tax / PBT; used as an explicit cash-tax proxy, not a forecast of current/deferred taxes or a marginal rate. Molycop 27% is still an unresolved model input: no verified guidance/consensus/standalone tax history. No cross-border loss offsets.
shared.pending_issue_rationale: Main pro-forma valuation includes follow-on shares and matching unreceived cash once; legal issuance completion remains unverified.
shared.discount_rate_rationale: Entity CAPM/financing inputs and EV weights are in pro_forma.wacc; see their source/proxy notes.

legacy_statement_policy.scope: Only previously unresolved legacy Tega statement lines. Existing operating, tax, debt and asset assumptions have priority. Molycop forecasts are unchanged.
legacy_statement_policy.historical_other_income: FY25 effective interest yield on average FY24/FY25 cash and bank balances, applied to opening forecast cash. FY25 avoids the FY26 acquisition funding cash build-up. Miscellaneous receipts use the FY25/FY26 nominal average.
legacy_statement_policy.historical_jv: FY24-FY26 average annual equity-accounted profit and cash dividend, prorated to the forecast period. Dividends cannot exceed the available JV carrying value.
legacy_statement_policy.tax: Existing historical effective rate on positive taxable income; JV share of profit is already after JV tax. Deferred tax movements and incremental tax on subsidiary/JV distributions are zero modeling assumptions, not verified tax exemptions.
legacy_statement_policy.balance_sheet: Keep non-operating historical balances at FY26 nominal values unless a schedule determines them. Roll equity from reported FY26 equity plus reported Q1 legacy PAT, then forecast PAT less dividends. No equity or cash balancing plug.
legacy_statement_policy.asset_detail: Allocate the existing pooled asset cohorts into PPE, ROU and intangibles using reported opening balances and FY26 additions mix. Preserve aggregate depreciation and capex exactly; split pooled CWIP into tangible and intangible construction.
legacy_statement_policy.debt_detail: Allocate scheduled principal using historical lease/principal proportions, sweep bank debt before leases, and classify the next annual scheduled payments as current. Additional required funding is a current facility proxy; term borrowing becomes current within the existing parent-loan maturity window. This is a classification proxy, not contractual repayment guidance.
legacy_statement_policy.dividend_timing: One annual payment in July-March FY27; unchanged INR2/share annually thereafter. FY27 follows the proposed FY26 dividend; later years are a historical fallback.
legacy_statement_policy.opening_reconciliation: Keep the previously approved estimated June cash/debt bridge. Show any difference from the independently rolled FY26 opening balance sheet as a diagnostic; never fill it with a plug or call it zero.
legacy_statement_policy.molycop_investment: Show the existing parent cash contribution at cost solely in this legacy-only statement view. Existing subsidiary cash distributions are dividend income here; do not add the investment or dividend to group FCFF/DCF again.

drivers.method: 100% consolidation with investment/dividend eliminations; full preference/net-debt deductions plus common NCI; main count includes follow-on pro forma. See adjacent input notes.

pro_forma._ev_note: USER FIRST-PASS WEIGHT: USD1455m. Closing filing rounds deal EV to USD1500m. Weight is not purchase equity consideration. No disclosed legacy Tega acquisition EV exists; use the separately labeled operating EV proxy below, not post-acquisition Tega market capitalization.
pro_forma._tega_ev_note: UNSOURCED analyst starting proxy INR80000m (INR8000 crore), for standalone legacy operating EV only. Replace with an independently supported legacy operating EV. Not market consensus and not a disclosed transaction EV.
pro_forma._ownership_note: Closing ordinary contribution ratio gives Apollo 15.8213105%; user 84.12%/15.82% fails 100% check. Override can be supplied; Tega always equals 1 minus NCI.

shares._note: First issue already in FY26 shares/cash. Main valuation includes proposed follow-on pro forma, with matching cash once. Completion not verified; 22 August filing is subject to approvals. No other dilutive instruments identified.

consolidation._note: UNSOURCED allocation proxies: AR + inventory - AP = NWC; opening Molycop cash zero is a gross/net presentation assumption. Lease USD10m is allocated OUT OF the existing USD50m other-claims reserve, not added to DCF claims again. Missing acquired assets/liabilities are fixed opening allocations against reported June group control totals, not new forecast balancing plugs. Intercompany trading/receivable balances assumed zero; investment and dividend eliminations are mandatory. NCI book defaults to ordinary contribution, distinct from fair-value NCI in DCF.
